notes: Prices in JPY from SNKRDUNK. This is run7, a same-day follow-up to run6 (2026-09-17 ~09:01 JST) collected via the built-in browser pane (Claude in Chrome extension was not connected this run) at an 800x1061 viewport. Listings filtered to 販売中のみ (for-sale only); top-20 cheapest active listings taken per grade, with a 15% cutoff above the lowest listing (threshold = lowest * 1.15) splitting them into within_15pct vs excluded_over_15pct. The site's 安い順 (cheapest-first) sort was applied via the JS native-setter workaround and verified via screenshot (no SOLD-badge leakage) before extracting the top 20. recent_completed_sales are the most recent ~15-20 sales-history entries per grade, oldest-to-newest, filtered by the 状態 grade pill on the card's 売買履歴 section (Card 2's grade-filter modal briefly multi-selected 'PSA10,A' after switching grades - fixed by re-opening the modal and explicitly unchecking PSA10, leaving only A). PSA10 population/gem-rate sourced from altema.jp (pokekachi) for the 5 established cards, all re-verified unchanged from run6 (10846/88.0%, 20026/88.7%, 80321/86.9%, 8102/81.5%, 49275/86.6%). image_url reused from the skill's cached table for all 11 cards (no re-fetching needed). All 6 M6a '30th CELEBRATION' cards (released 2026-09-16) still have zero PSA10 listings/sales and no altema.jp PSA10 population data, now confirmed unchanged across two same-day checks (run6 morning, run7 afternoon) - PSA grading turnaround takes weeks, so this is expected. Their A-grade markets remain extremely active on day 2 post-release, with recent sales-history turnover in the minutes-to-under-2-hours-old range across all 6 cards. Two notable listing changes among the M6a cards versus run6: Card 6 (ゲンガーex SAR)'s BGS9.5 listing at ~4,900 yen seen in run6 is no longer active (sold or delisted, tile reverted to 出品待ち), while Card 8 (ジラーチex SAR)'s equivalent BGS9.5 listing at ~4,900 yen is still active and unchanged. Similarly, Card 11 (ピカチュウex SAR, night version)'s PSA9 listing at ~10,500 yen seen in run6 is no longer active (tile reverted to 出品待ち) - no PSA10 listings have appeared for any M6a card yet. Notable findings among the 5 established cards vs run6 (collected the same day, ~09:01 JST): (1) Card 3 (ブラッキーex SAR, Umbreon ex) PSA10 lowest listing has risen sharply from run6's ¥68,000 to ¥73,000 now, a genuine ~7% increase within the same day, continuing the upward reversal run6 first flagged versus run5. (2) Card 4 (ゲンガーVMAX SA) PSA10 lowest listing has dropped further, from run6's ¥285,000 to ¥280,000 - the multi-week downward trend is continuing without interruption. (3) Card 5 (名探偵ピカチュウ プロモ) A-grade price has dropped sharply and more decisively into the ¥27,000-28,000 cluster over the last 1-2 days, an acceleration of the recent-drop trend run6 already identified (run6 had it stabilizing around ¥26,500-28,000; this run's sales history confirms a firm break below the prior ~¥32,000-38,500 range with no reversion). pokeca-chart.com index figures are byte-for-byte identical to run6's, as expected per the skill's documented behavior since both runs occurred on the same JST calendar day (the index's data_range only advances once per day, reflecting the last fully-completed day of data: 2026/09/16) - PSA10 index at 115,636 yen (day -1.8%, month -23.2%, year +21.4%), raw/美品 index at 52,303 yen (day -0.1%, month -3.8%, year +29.8%). Transaction-volume overlay: the PSA10 index chart showed a pronounced volume spike roughly mid-September (the tallest bar in the trailing month), with volume elevated through the first half of the month and more moderate over the most recent few days. The raw/美品 index chart showed comparatively steady volume through most of the month that tapered off noticeably in the last several days, coinciding with the index's recent month-over-month price decline. psa_tier_status omitted this run (JST is Thursday, not Monday; the weekly PSA Value-tier check runs Mondays only).
